scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved algebraically and finite tests are only regression corroboration. Prior automatic-congruence and Delannoy results are credited; unresolved risk of an earlier equivalent theorem remains.
scientific_limitations: The local zero digit set is finite but not parametrized for every prime. No pointwise gcd growth, complete prime-adic valuation, independent verification, or publication-level novelty certification is claimed.
title: Density-one common divisors for consecutive central Delannoy numbers
